title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Wine Aft Tour with Cheese from Niagara Falls
includes: Cheese pairing with wine at one winery
Pickup and drop-off from most Niagara Falls and Niagara-on-the-Lake accommodations
Three to four wine samples at each winery
Individual wine purchases are extra (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of two people per booking is required
Drinking age is 19 years old and up
policies: Minimum numbers apply. There is a possibility of cancellation after confirmation if there are not enough guests to meet requirements. In the event of this occurring, an alternative or full refund will be offered
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Sip, savor, and stroll through Niagara on the Lake's estate vineyards and discover hidden-gem wineries on this 3.5-4 hour winery tour. Explore Niagara on the Lake's beautiful grassroots wineries, meet wine lover's, sommelier's, and even winemakers! Taste Ontario's (VQA) wines in barrel cellars and private tasting rooms, while sampling award-winning white, red, rose, sparkling, and ice wines. Enjoy a market fresh cheese platter, paired with tutored wine tasting while learning more about food and wine pairings.  Sample 9-12 wines, learn about Niagara's wine making process, meet passionate wine lovers, and capture memorable moments in wineries and vineyards. Browse and shop each unique winery boutique for new favorites to take home. Typically our group sizes are more intimate; usually 4-10 guests. Although weekends are typically busier, choosing a midweek date allows for more personal attention while on tour.
